framework.note: Mandates disclosure of acquisition of shares exceeding 25% threshold or formal announcement of takeover offer; prescribes timing, contents and mode of disclosure to shareholders and exchanges.

Governs open offer mechanics, pricing, acceptance period (60 days), and mandatory public announcement requirements.
Defines control and substantial interest in context of board composition and disclosure obligations.
Grants SEBI power to regulate substantial acquisitions and takeovers.

headline: Semac Construction Limited files Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Semac Construction Limited has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Reg. 31(4), indicating a triggering event requiring public disclosure of shareholding changes or acquisition intent.
detail: The filing submitted to NSE indicates compliance with SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), which mandates disclosure when a person acquires shares exceeding prescribed thresholds or when a takeover process is formally announced. The exact acquiring party, consideration amount, and shareholding acquired are contained in the referenced disclosure document. Given the filing date of 18 June 2026, the open offer (if applicable) timeline and other regulatory conditions precedent should be tracked against the Takeover Regulations framework.
